## Overview

Ongoing prototyping and research-software engineering within the **Digital Health Research** unit at **Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK)**, supporting multidisciplinary studies alongside psychologists and healthcare researchers.

## Highlights

- **VR Study on Women's Self-Objectification (2026):** Designed the technical solution, rapid prototype development, and ongoing maintenance for an experimental VR research study.
- **Dheal-com — *"Eccipienti Digitali"* (2025):** Contributed prototype development within the Dheal-com initiative exploring digital health interventions.
